name: greenbatch
description: Marketplace for the greenbatch dependency-update skill: one verified branch and 1-2 PRs per run, instead of one PR and one full CI pipeline per package.

plugins.name: greenbatch
plugins.description: Tiered, gated, bisected dependency updates for npm and Maven. One verified branch and one PR per target branch, with a report of what was kept, reverted, and skipped - and what was deliberately not taken.
